purpose: Prepare L099 for symbolic_checked review by decomposing PO-GEO-001 into four individually checkable sub-obligations and registering the tau_geo trace map operator. Does not promote geometry_app.

sub_obligations_registered.name: Distinction Preservation
sub_obligations_registered.failure_mode: projection collapses distinct topology into indistinguishable geometry
sub_obligations_registered.symbolic_check_target: Equivalence relation on Geometry_app may not collapse non-equivalent topology classes

sub_obligations_registered.name: Admissibility Preservation
sub_obligations_registered.failure_mode: projection creates illegal geometry from admissible topology
sub_obligations_registered.symbolic_check_target: P_adm must apply to the codomain without exception

sub_obligations_registered.name: Orientation Trace Preservation
sub_obligations_registered.claim: orientation class of T remains recoverable from Pi_geo(T)
sub_obligations_registered.failure_mode: selector information becomes unrecoverable after projection
sub_obligations_registered.symbolic_check_target: tau_geo(Pi_geo(T)) retains orientation class label; requires OBJ-GEO-TRACE-001

sub_obligations_registered.name: Closure Trace Preservation
sub_obligations_registered.claim: closure identity of T remains traceable after Pi_geo(T)
sub_obligations_registered.failure_mode: projection destroys closure lineage or aliases distinct closures
sub_obligations_registered.symbolic_check_target: tau_geo(Pi_geo(T)) retains closure identity; tau_geo injective w.r.t. closure equivalence classes; requires OBJ-GEO-TRACE-001

new_formal_objects_registered.critical_test: tau_geo(Pi_geo(T)) preserves required invariant labels of T

promotion_gate.PO-GEO-001_to_symbolic_checked: All four sub-obligations must reach explicit_defined; no failure condition may be suppressed
promotion_gate.L099_to_symbolic_checked: Follows from PO-GEO-001 symbolic_checked; geometry_app remains at C1_STRUCTURAL_PROJECTION_ONLY
promotion_gate.geometry_app_unaffected: geometry_app remains C1_STRUCTURAL_PROJECTION_ONLY even after L099 reaches symbolic_checked; requires GEO-CAMPAIGN-001 separately

open_obligations_after_patch.description: Run explicit symbolic check for distinction preservation
Run explicit symbolic check for admissibility preservation
Run explicit symbolic check for orientation trace via tau_geo
Run explicit symbolic check for closure trace via tau_geo; verify tau_geo injectivity on closure classes
Execute GEO_PROJECTION_VALIDATION_001 with all four adversarial controls
